Keisha (Support): Heads-up: KitePilot is getting 403 on SSO provisioning this AM, blocking activation. Renewal review in 10 days, customer frustrated. Escalating to CS for priority handoff.
Lina (Customer Success): Thanks Keisha. Can you drop the logged error and primary contact?
Keisha (Support): Log: 2024-05-22T09:41:12Z authproxy ERROR tenant=kitepilot code=403 detail="idp_token_invalid" user_email=j.doe@kitepilot.ai. Contact: Jordan Cole (ops). They said "need this live by next week".
Ops Bot: Alert INC-4821 created (authproxy-sso 5x 403s in 7m).
Ben (Onboarding Eng): Short-term workaround: we can issue a 24h onboarding service key while we rotate their IdP cert. Cmd: redwoodctl keys create --tenant=kitepilot --scope=onboard --ttl=24h. Requires Ops approval for secret rotation.
Ethan (Account Exec): KitePilot is mid-market strategic; please cc me on comms and timeline.
Lina (Customer Success): Draft comms plan: 1) immediate ack + offer temp key (target <2h); 2) IdP cert rotation + verification (target 24h); 3) pre-renewal check-in and usage summary (target 7d). I'll own outreach.
Ben (Onboarding Eng): Temp key prep ~5m. Full rotation on our side ~30-60m; customer must provide IdP admin or one-time admin link.
Keisha (Support): Customer sentiment: "we're on the clock" and may evaluate alternatives. Marking renewal risk elevated.
Lina (Customer Success): Action items: @Keisha share incident link and extra logs; @Ben stand by to generate temp key when Ops approves; @Ethan join verification call. I'll schedule a 15m warm handoff with KitePilot + Support + Onboarding in 30m and send initial note now.
Keisha (Support): Incident link DM'd to Lina, logs uploaded to INC-4821.
Ben (Onboarding Eng): Temp key ready on standby.
Lina (Customer Success): Sending initial acknowledgement to Jordan now. Will update renewal risk tracker after handoff.
Ethan (Account Exec): Thanks team, please keep me looped and I'll prep the VP Eng renewal talking points.
